Restarted launchd-managed Mother on installed v0.71.0 and live-smoked README markdown buffer over UDS: shape listed, open returned `*README.md*` markdown buffer, payload path resolved to project README, and payload replay returned content via `/api/view-buffers/<buffer_id>/payload`.

Added `patina mother view` CLI under Mother with `shapes`, `buffers`, `open`, and `payload`; `cargo run -q -- mother view open README.md` opens the Mother-owned `*README.md*` buffer and renders markdown content in terminal.

Added `patina mother view open <target> --tmux` with Doom/vi-style `-s/--below` and `-v/--right`; tmux panes run `patina mother view payload <buffer-id> | less -R -X` so mouse/tmux scrollback behaves better than the initial plain less pane.
